sources.title: Bodily maps of emotions
sources.scope: Participants marked emotion-associated sensations on body silhouettes.
sources.limitations: Self-report maps are not direct physiological measurements or diagnostic probabilities.

sources.title: Emotion fingerprints or emotion populations?
sources.scope: Meta-analysis of autonomic measures across emotion categories.
sources.limitations: Variation and overlap limit inference of a unique emotion from an isolated bodily sign.

sources.title: Emotional Expressions Reconsidered
sources.scope: Evaluates facial movements and emotion inference.
sources.limitations: Facial appearance alone is insufficient to establish an emotional state across contexts.

sources.title: Autonomic nervous system activity distinguishes among emotions
sources.scope: Autonomic measures during posed facial actions and relived experiences.
sources.limitations: Task-specific group findings do not supply probabilities for the atlas claims.

sources.title: Cardiovascular, electrodermal, and respiratory response patterns to fear- and sadness-inducing films
sources.scope: Measured cardiovascular, skin-conductance and respiratory responses to films.
sources.limitations: Experimental induction and selected measures do not imply a universal everyday response.

sources.title: The spontaneous expression of pride and shame
sources.scope: Observed postures after victory or defeat among sighted and blind athletes.
sources.limitations: Sporting context and cultural modulation, particularly of shame, limit generalization.

sources.title: Piloerection is not a reliable physiological correlate of awe
sources.scope: Two preregistered samples tested objective goosebumps after awe stimuli.
sources.limitations: Results concern the tested laboratory stimuli, not all possible awe experiences.

sources.title: Panic Disorder: What You Need to Know
sources.scope: Descriptions of panic symptoms and evaluation.
sources.limitations: Symptoms overlap other conditions; this catalogue is not a diagnostic instrument.

sources.title: Facial Action Coding System
sources.scope: FACS describes visible facial actions; scoring requires trained observation.
sources.limitations: The full licensed manual was not reproduced or independently certified against these generated images.

sources.title: OpenFace Action Units
sources.scope: Lists the action-unit subset recognized by the research tool.
sources.limitations: Tool outputs and generated reference images are not proof of an emotional state.
